name: io.github.pedrosalvadeo/genius-decision
title: Genius Decision
description: Create and evaluate versioned decision models with reproducible results and declared assumptions.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional for public discovery. Private tools require Bearer followed by a scoped agent token; obtain it through https://geniusdecision.app/agents.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.limitations: Evaluations consume shared quota. Results are conditional on declared models and do not establish empirical validity. Registration default scopes do not include twin tools.
